LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 7.1.1 SELF- EXPRESSION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Self- expression
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Self- expression, part of Strand 7 in Grade 4 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: how one can best use their leisure time. 1. How do you spend your leisure time? 2. Why should we express our opinions?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. collaboratively listen to an audio recording on leisure activities,

2. cooperate with peers to list constructive leisure activities,

3. conduct a discussion while using interjections appropriately to express varied emotions

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. collaboratively listen to an audio recording on leisure activities,
2. cooperate with peers to list constructive leisure activities,
3. conduct a discussion while using interjections appropriately to express varied emotions

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Self- expression together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: This is enhanced as the learner interacts with digital content when listening to recorded clips on leisure

activities.

• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: This is developed as the learner explores views when presenting views about ideas in

a poem.

Values:
• Responsibility: This is promoted as the learner takes up assigned roles when working collaboratively with peers to compose

a poem based on the theme.

• Unity: This is cultivated as learner collaborates with peers to conduct a debate on use of leisure time.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peer pressure awareness: This is promoted as the learner finds better and constructive ways to use their leisure time.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can learn the concept of constructive use of leisure time and relate it with similar concept in Religious Education.
